remarks: HIGHEST & BEST DUE FRIDAY AT 5PM. This exceptional multi-family home in the heart of Glenbrook presents a premier opportunity for both savvy investors and owner-occupants. Spanning over 3,500 square feet, the property features six bedrooms and five and a half bathrooms across three distinct living spaces, providing incredible flexibility and significant income potential. Ideally situated on a level lot, the property offers bright, well-maintained units, public utilities, and ample parking. The primary residence functions as a spacious single-family home with four bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms. The main level includes a family room, living room, and a dining room that flows into a large eat-in kitchen with direct deck access. Upstairs, the primary suite features a walk-in closet and ensuite bath, while three additional bedrooms share a full bathroom. The fully finished lower level adds significant value with a large rec room, full bath, laundry, and garage access. The two additional one bedroom, one full bathroom units feature spacious living areas and functional kitchens, with one offering a convenient breakfast bar and the other a modern open-concept layout. Located just minutes from the Glenbrook Metro-North station, this property offers an effortless commute to NYC and represents a rare find with significant income potential and flexible living arrangements.
